front: Active search period for subsequent events
back: From the balance sheet date to the report date.
"March 1, except for Note X, as to which the date is March 8" — extends responsibility only for that event.
Extends subsequent-events responsibility for all events to the new date.

front: Subsequently discovered facts — management won't revise
back: Notify TCWG and take steps to prevent reliance.
Assess their importance; if they impair the opinion and users rely on it, perform them or alternatives.

front: Type I vs. Type II events
back: Type I: condition existed at the balance sheet date → adjust. Type II: arose after → disclose.
